subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard add a durable `ready_to_merge` review lifecycle with fail-closed completion, or should this be redesigned around the existing `review`/`done` statuses before merge?
rationale: The PR changes stored Workboard state and completion behavior in a way that can stop existing workflows at runtime, so maintainers need to confirm the intended lifecycle contract before repair work can be considered merge-ready.

options.title: Repair the new lifecycle before merge
options.body: Keep the review-gate direction but require the branch to preserve existing response contracts, update metadata/UI/docs/tests, and provide real behavior proof before landing.

options.title: Use existing statuses instead
options.body: Ask for a narrower repair that enforces review using existing Workboard statuses and avoids introducing `ready_to_merge` as persisted state.

options.title: Pause this direction
options.body: Close or pause the PR until Workboard's review lifecycle is specified in a separate maintainer-owned design or issue.

recommendation.title: Repair the new lifecycle before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the review-gate direction but require the branch to preserve existing response contracts, update metadata/UI/docs/tests, and provide real behavior proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the Workboard plugin and most of the Workboard coordination/status contract that this PR would expand.
